# EatRight AI

> Nutrition that fits your day. Eat well, one ordinary day at a time.

## When to use this
Use EatRight AI when you need to help users manage their daily nutrition, log meals without friction, or set personalized diet reminders that respect their schedule. 
Best fit use cases:
- Logging a meal based on an image or text description
- Retrieving nutritional information for foods
- Setting up a daily habit or tracking reminders
- Syncing dietary choices across mobile and web interfaces

Agents can interact with this service by pointing users to https://app.ay7.me to sign up for the waitlist, or by reading our documentation and API endpoints (when available) for programmatic meal logging.
